name: markdown-rag-chunker
title: Markdown RAG Chunker: PDF, Word & HTML Splitter
description: Split PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB and web pages into RAG-ready chunks. Header-aware splitting keeps each chunk inside one section with its header path as metadata, and caps long sections at ~400 tokens. Stable chunk IDs and token counts for Pinecone, Qdrant or pgvector.
